tool_input.command: git diff -U0 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/KoBoToolbox | grep -E '^\+' | grep -nE '\bas\b'; echo "exit=$?"
tool_input.description: Check added lines for remaining as-casts

result:
I removed the `as` casts from the new code. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked.

- **`KoBoToolbox.node.ts`**: the `setValidationMany` block no longer casts `getNodeParameter` results. The status goes through an `isString` type guard (lodash) that throws a `NodeOperationError` if it is not a string. The submission IDs go straight into `parseSubmissionIds`.
- **`GenericFunctions.ts`**: `parseSubmissionIds` now takes `value: unknown` instead of `string`. It still converts the value with lodash `toString`, so no cast or guard is needed there.

The added import order (`lodash/isString` above the `n8n-workflow` type import) may not match the repo's lint ordering. I did not check it because you asked me not to run lint.

The `formId` in the new block comes from the existing `as string` line above the block. That line was already in the file and is outside the new code, so I left it. If you want it cleaned up too, it needs the same guard treatment.
